reviewMethod.wholeSourcePurity: Every candidate was reviewed across full-source 15 fps whole-body and lower-body evidence before any count was admitted.
reviewMethod.densePassReview: The single PASS clip was re-reviewed with original ~30 fps frames around 40 candidate cycles and the source boundary. Each admitted cycle was visually checked as synchronized two-foot takeoff/airborne/landing.
reviewMethod.locatorPolicy: Programmatic dark-pixel/body-motion analysis was used only to propose candidate timestamps for the PASS clip. It did not decide type and did not generate the GT count.
reviewMethod.mixedTypePolicy: Any alternate-foot, high-knee, crossover, lateral/non-basic footwork, or mixed subtype anywhere in the source rejects the clip from STANDARD.
